protocol.auc: macro one-vs-rest ROC AUC computed from softmax probabilities
protocol.class_metrics: unweighted macro averages across 100 one-vs-rest classes
protocol.comparison_scope: matched dataset, split, input size, and recorded recipe; this is a fixed-recipe comparison, not a claim that each architecture received its individually optimal recipe
protocol.flops_method: Analytical estimate: Conv2d, Linear, multi-head/window-attention matrix operations, cosine-classifier matrix multiplication, and approximate 2D FFT work. Uses 2 FLOPs/MAC; excludes normalization, activation, softmax, pooling, and most elementwise operations.
protocol.inference_timing: single-image latency is measured on-device at batch size 1; batched inference FPS is model-only wall time at the reported batch size; pipeline throughput includes loading the test batches
protocol.selection_rule: checkpoint selected by validation top-1 before test evaluation
protocol.test: same official CIFAR-100 10,000-image test split for every checkpoint
protocol.test_set_history: Test images were excluded from training and validation, but earlier pilot and pipeline runs inspected this official test split. It is not a pristine blinded confirmatory set for this project.
protocol.train_validation: same stratified 45,000/5,000 split from the official 50,000-image training set; split seed 1729, 50 validation images per class
